---
name: Reproducibility discrepancy
about: A number, table or claim in the manuscript or docs does not match what the code produces
labels: reproducibility
---

**Claim and location** (manuscript section / table / document)

**What the code produced** (command, commit hash, prediction file hash)

**Artifacts you can supply** (run logs, prediction CSVs, split manifests) — these are what resolve discrepancies;
see `docs/known_discrepancies.md`.

**Do not attach patient images or protected health information.**
